testdescription: Acceptor control point: execute the opted-in live provider and controlled-Neo4j flow using generated canaries through each approved source, direct process environment and the unique repository-relative .argo/.env, then exercise process/file agreement, process precedence, conflicting duplicates, canonical Neo4j names, ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL-to-neo4jUri resolution, QWEN_KEY-to-embeddingCredential resolution, missing/blank values, alternate or tracked files, reparse/path indirection, broad Windows ACLs, command-line/default/fallback/legacy-alias/runtime-field sources, and inspect all observable channels. Observation point: only QWEN_KEY and ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD may be loaded as approved secrets; ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL is the only approved source for runtime neo4jUri; QWEN_KEY is the only approved source for runtime embeddingCredential; ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_URL, ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_USERNAME, and ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD are the accepted Neo4j configuration names; mismatches and every unsafe, legacy-alias, runtime-field, unresolved neo4jUri, unresolved embeddingCredential, or unapproved source fail closed before provider, database, or index side effects; ARGO_NEO4J_DATABASE_PASSWORD is used only by the database authentication connection layer and neither secret enters stdout/stderr, errors, logs, Cypher text/parameters, graph evidence, failure records, snapshots, or artifacts; cleanup leaves zero persistence and zero generated secret artifacts.
